origin: Approved PAKIET 01-27 split after 17 articles reached the full publication gate
required_gate: Full ARTICLE_STANDARD.md gate used for a new article: editorial and medical evidence review, FAQ provenance, intent and cannibalization, contextual internal links, schema and metadata, reviewed hero plus one distinct image per substantive H2, desktop/mobile preview, regenerated and page-by-page reviewed PDF, source/_site equality, sitemap and production validation
content_rules: No generic filler or artificial section minimum
Length follows the topic; long articles are allowed
Medical claims use relevant authoritative primary sources, guidelines or systematic reviews
A watermark alone does not block an image; misleading text, numbers, anatomy, equipment or context do
Every machine-detectable defect is fixed both in the article and in the pipeline with a regression test
publication_rule: Repair all 10 in isolated staging and publish them as one atomic package only after every gate passes. Then commit, push, verify production and prepare the GSC URL list.
